title: Share the Display: fits any browser · floating tools · type your own role
intro: The viewer page fits small laptop screens, the witness's tools float where they want them, and the people list is alphabetical.

items.t: The viewer page fits the viewer's browser: the top bar wraps onto a second line instead of cutting buttons off, and the picture resizes to the space left.
items.where: Viewer page (upload the new viewer page to your web host)

items.t: Floating tool bar for the witness: page, zoom and Go to page in one bar over the picture that always fits inside the browser window (it shrinks to fit a small screen). ⠿ drag it anywhere, ⟲ turn it upright, A− / A+ size it, ▾ tuck it away (double-click ⠿ to put it back at the bottom).
items.where: Viewer page → when the witness has control

items.t: Role: pick one from the list or type your own ("Custodian of Records"), when joining or later at the top.
Everyone watching is listed in alphabetical order, in the viewer's people list and in the app.
items.where: Viewer page → 👥 · Display window → Share the Display

items.t: Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Outline (BETA): the attorney's outline, with its documents in order
intro: Add the attorney's outline and every document it mentions becomes a chip you click to show — in order, beside History.

items.t: Outline (BETA): add the attorney's outline — Word, PDF, email (.eml), text, or pasted. Every Tab, exhibit number, ID, Bates number or file name it mentions becomes a chip: “Tab 1 – introduce” gives a Tab 1 chip, “Tab 1, page 3” a chip that opens page 3. Click a chip and it goes on the table you're on (in LIVE it shows right away); right-click for Open on current table or Open in new table. ◀ Back / Next ▶ step through the outline's documents in order, and shown ones get a green ✓.
items.where: Add → Outline…  (the Outline panel opens under History)

items.t: Deposition or trial outline: a deposition outline is one witness, section by section. A trial outline follows the order of witnesses (“Plaintiff calls Dr. Ortiz”, “Cross of Hale”): the panel shows the witness now and their exhibits, with Next witness ▶. A ✓ by the name means they're on the job's witness list.
items.where: Add → Outline… → Deposition outline / Trial outline

items.t: Anything the outline mentions that matches no file (say “Exhibit 44”) shows in orange — click it and choose the file. Valu-Present remembers the link; the outline itself is never changed.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Share the Display: fit to page and HI-RES
intro: Viewers see the page as large as their window allows, and can turn on HI-RES for sharper text.

items.t: Fit to page: viewers see just the page and its label bar, as large as their browser window allows — more than twice the size in a tall window. A Page / Screen switch at the top shows the whole Display when they want it; side-by-side, video and slides always show the whole Display.

HI-RES: a viewer can turn on sharper pages (the Display drawn 2560 wide just for them). If their connection cannot keep up, it turns itself off and tells them; everyone else keeps the standard picture.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Share the Display: one-click links, zoom for the witness, virtual display
intro: Invitations are one paste, the witness can zoom and scroll, and the session code lasts the day.

items.t: One-click links: the invitation link carries the passcode (option, on by default), so a click plus their name gets them in. One invitation box with Copy invitation — the click-to-join link, plus the plain link, session code and passcode for anyone who types them. Pastes cleanly into Zoom chat or an email.
Witness control adds Zoom in / out, Fit page, and the mouse wheel: scroll a zoomed page up and down, or a firm scroll turns the page. Anything you do still takes control back.

Same code and passcode for the job for 24 hours: close Valu-Present by accident and share again — the invitation still works, and viewers get a Rejoin. After 24 hours (or New code) it is forgotten. The passcode is kept in your computer's keychain only.
Viewers see your own clear screen (logo, presenter name) when nothing is up, with a small “Waiting for the next document…” tag.
Save viewer page files… (App Settings → Sharing the Display): the three files and a how-to, for a firm that hosts the page on its own web server or GitHub.
“Also open a separate app window” is now Create virtual display, and it shows as its own tile next to your monitors. Sync a Deposition is marked BETA.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Share the Display: video with sound · witness control on request
intro: Clips play with sound in the viewer's browser, and the witness can ask to turn the pages.

items.t: Share the Display: video and audio clips play live in the viewer's browser, with sound. Each viewer has their own sound button, volume and mute (sound starts after one click — browsers require it). Documents stay as sharp still pages. On a relay connection viewers see still pictures and a note.

Request control: a witness taps ✋ Request control in their browser; a banner at the top of the app shows their name with Allow and Deny. Control means turning pages and Go to page ___. Marking (pen, highlight, arrow) is a separate Mark tick per person. Anything you do to the Display takes control back at once, and the witness is told to ask again. Everything is logged.
Viewers can change their role after joining (top of their screen); everyone's list updates.
App Settings → Sharing the Display: the viewer page address (empty = the Valu-Present page; a firm can use its own copy on another GitHub or its own website) and an optional own relay.
items.where: App Settings → Presenting → Sharing the Display

items.t: Viewers see “Waiting for the next document…” instead of a black screen when nothing is on the Display.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Simpler sticker settings · Share panel pops out
intro: The sticker settings follow the sticker from top to bottom, and the Share panel can sit on its own monitor.

items.t: Sticker settings in the order of the sticker: Type, Layout, Lettering, Header, Witness name, Under the line, Color. The line under the sticker is always your Entity name (the court reporter choices are gone), and the witness name is no longer put in front of the designation.
Share the Display: the Who's watching panel pops out (↗) into its own window, so it can sit on another monitor. Closing that window puts it back on the bottom bar.

Share the Display: closing Valu-Present tells every viewer the session ended. If the computer drops off (asleep, network lost), the viewer page says so within about half a minute instead of showing the last picture.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Sharing in the Display window · Finals folder up front
intro: Turn on sharing where you pick the Display, and choose where marked exhibits go at the top of the sticker settings.

items.t: Share the Display now lives in the Display window: two switches — Same room (this network) and Anywhere (internet). Turn one on and the session code, passcode, links and Copy invitation appear right there; each can be turned on or off while people watch. Who's watching (Control / Remove) is one click away.
items.where: Display button on the top bar

items.t: Exhibit sticker settings: where marked exhibits are saved is now at the top, with Choose folder… and Open buttons. The two rarely used options (name on party exhibits, place on any page) are gone — stickers go on the first page, as before.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Share the Display: viewer page built in
intro: The internet link works out of the box — nothing to set up.

items.t: Share the Display: the internet link now uses the Valu-Present viewer page (holmstockd.github.io/watch) out of the box, so every tech can share right away. A firm that wants its own copy of the viewer page can host it and set the address under Share the Display → Advanced.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Share the Display in any browser · resume where you left off
intro: Judge, counsel and the witness can watch the Display live in a web browser — same room or anywhere — and a job opens where you left it.

items.t: Share the Display (BETA): judge, counsel and the witness watch the Display live in any web browser — nothing to install. In the same room they use a link to your computer; anywhere else, a link plus a session code and passcode. Each person signs in with a full legal name (role optional, e.g. Witness, Counsel for Plaintiff, Judge) and everyone sees who is watching. Only the Display is sent — never your private tables. The picture goes computer to computer, encrypted; if a network blocks that, it goes through the relay (slower).

Allow control: give one person control to turn pages and draw (pen, highlight, arrow) on the Display. Their marks show on the Display, your Counsel Table and every viewer, and History records them by name. Take control back or remove someone at any time.
Right-click a document or a page → Open in a new table: it opens on its own table, private until you press LIVE or SHOW.

Welcome back: when you open a job it offers to pick up where you left off — every table as you left it (pages, callouts, highlights, names, colours) and the tab you were on. Nothing goes on the Display until you press LIVE or SHOW. Start clean is one click.
Session time carries on: continue the last session's clock when you reopen the job, or start a new session. The bottom bar shows this session and the job's total time.

Import coding from a review platform (BETA): Concordance .DAT, Summation .DII, Opticon .OPT or a CSV / tab list. Each record is matched to your documents by Bates (page Bates, file name or Bates range); a preview shows what matched before anything changes. The coding shows in Exhibit Details, Find searches it, and the Coding chip filters by any field (Custodian, Issues, Privilege…). The .OPT can fill in missing page Bates numbers.
items.where: Add → Coding from a review platform…

items.t: Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Sticker preview matches · F4 names stand out
intro: The Exhibit Marking preview shows the sticker you will actually mark, and page names you gave with F4 are pure white.

items.t: The sticker in the Exhibit Marking panel (Next · click to change) and the size preview now match the sticker Mark puts on the page — Classic layout, header, lettering and what goes under the line. It was still drawing the old black-band sticker.
Page names you give with F4 are pure white and bold (pure black on light themes), shown or not — they are your markers in the document. File names stay silver.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Shown exhibits: green ID, names keep their look
intro: Once a page has been shown, its ID turns green; the name stays silver, or white if you named it.

items.t: Shown pages and documents: only the ID turns green, with a green ✓ after the name. The name keeps its own look — a file name stays silver, a page you named with F4 stays white and bold.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Tables: Ctrl/⌘ shortcuts · quieter tabs
intro: Switch Tables with Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+6 (⌘1 … ⌘6 on Mac). Tabs you are not on are just a label.

items.t: Switch Tables with Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+6 on Windows and Linux, ⌘1 … ⌘6 on Mac — like browser tabs. 📌 Home table is Ctrl/⌘+9. Case File is back on Alt+3.

A tab you are not on shows only its label — the exhibit, the page and its Bates number — with no buttons. Click it and it opens to full width with LIVE, SHOW and ✕. Its number still turns red when that table is LIVE and gold when it is shown.

The LIVE button on top (and F5) works on the table you are on: with another table on the Display, it now puts this table LIVE. It used to turn LIVE off and close the Display. SHOW (F6) works the same way.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Tables: order, colour, clearer tabs
intro: Drag Tables into any order, give them a colour, and always see which one you are on.

items.t: Drag a table's tab left or right to put the tables in any order (or right-click → Move left / Move right). Alt+1 … Alt+6 follow the new order.
Colour a table: right-click its tab → Color… (the same colours as Case File folders). The colour shows along the top of the tab and on its number.
The tab you are on stands out: taller, joined to the page, a bright bar on top and a bold white name. The other tabs are quieter. No more tab animation.
LIVE on an empty table works: the Display clears, and whatever you call up on that table shows at once (it said “Nothing in the viewer to send”).
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Tables · new exhibit sticker options
intro: Work on up to six Tables at once, each with its own LIVE and SHOW. Exhibit stickers get every type, a Classic look, a header line and a default you set once.

items.t: Tables: the Counsel Table now has browser-style tabs — Table 1, Table 2 … up to six. Click a tab to work on it; only that table is shown to you. Each tab has its own LIVE and SHOW buttons, so the jury sees whatever you last sent while you prepare the next table in private. The LIVE light follows the table on the Display. Tabs are named from what they show (EX1 · p.2) or double-click to rename. Drag a tab to put it in any order; right-click → Color… to colour it. ＋ adds one, ✕ closes it.
items.where: Counsel Table tabs · Alt+1 … Alt+6 · 📌 Home table Alt+0

items.t: Exhibit stickers: every exhibit type is in the Type list (Plaintiff's, Defendant's, Joint, Court's, Demonstrative, For I.D. and more), with the right short code for each. New Classic layout — PLAINTIFF'S / EXHIBIT / 2 with name · date under a thin line — plus Lettering (Light, Bold, Extra bold), an optional Header line (e.g. SUPERIOR COURT or CONFIDENTIAL) and a choice of what goes under the line.
Make this my default sticker: tick it once and every new job starts with your sticker. Older jobs keep the sticker they had.

Drag any corner of a sticker to resize it (was the lower-right corner only); the pointer shows when you are on a corner. Batch numbering in order counts letters too — A, B … Z, AA · C-1, C-2 · PX-001, PX-002.
F4-named pages show white and bold in the file list, File Names are silver. Case File no longer uses Alt+3 (Alt+1 … Alt+6 now switch Tables).
Mac, Windows and Linux are built from one set of code.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Find: OCR only when you say so · Valu-Present for Linux
intro: Normal PDFs search instantly. A PDF that is only pictures of pages asks before reading.

items.t: Find in document: a normal PDF searches straight away, as in any PDF reader. A PDF that is only pictures of pages (scans, flattened productions) shows “Needs OCR to search — read it? Yes / No” next to Find. Yes reads the page on screen first and shows its matches, then the rest. The words are kept in the job, so each document is read only once, even after reopening. The original file is never changed.

Linux: Valu-Present is available as an AppImage (runs from anywhere) and a .deb installer for Zorin OS 17 and Ubuntu 22.04 or later. Cases, layouts and shortcuts are the same on Mac, Windows and Linux.
Linux: the Display goes full-screen on the monitor you choose, and follows a plug or unplug, on both Xorg and Wayland sessions.

Linux: the VALU-SYNC 2.0 engine, clip export and the A.I. all run on the CPU; Word, Excel and PowerPoint previews use LibreOffice (apt, snap or flatpak) when it is installed. Captions build the Speech Engine on your computer the first time (a few minutes).
Saved Screens → Export as PDF captured the wrong part of the window when Interface size was not 100 %. Fixed on every platform.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Better Find · Saved Screens to PDF · starting layouts
intro: Find in a document now steps through every match, Saved Screens can be saved as a PDF, and new jobs start with the layout you choose.

items.t: Find in document: Enter goes to the next match (not the next page), across pages. Words the PDF stores in pieces, and curly quotes, are found too. A scanned document shows “Read the pages”: click it and it can be searched. Find now searches only the document on screen (the All documents tick is gone; use Search Everything to search the whole case).

Export Saved Screens as a PDF: right-click a saved screen → Export as PDF…, or Export all saved screens as PDF…. Each page is the screen exactly as saved (zoom, highlights, callouts) with its code and name.
Starting layout for new jobs: choose one for depositions and one for trials in App Settings → Layout. A new job opens with it (or the clean layout) instead of the last job's layout.
items.where: App Settings → Layout → Starting layout for new jobs

items.t: 💾 Save layout asks: update the layout in use, or save as a new layout. The job always keeps what's on screen.
Sticker text comes back: the name, the agency band and custom sticker text you typed before are a ▾ click away. While marking, the bar has a Name field with names you typed before.
Previously marked also saves a plain copy (no sticker) in the job's Finals folder, named like “Previously Marked Defendant's Exhibit 4”, with the witness added when given.
Rename while importing: picking the characters of a number takes the whole number in every file, so Exhibit 1 … Exhibit 83 become 1 … 83. The rename codes are explained in plain words.
The Go To box under the Counsel Table is gone. Call up with X, and type a page number on the page chip.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Marking at a glance
intro: See how many exhibits are marked and how many are left, and previously marked exhibits stand out.

items.t: The bottom bar counts the exhibits: how many are marked, how many were previously marked, and how many are not marked yet. The bar's text is also bigger.

Previously marked exhibits have their own colour and a PREV tag in Files & Exhibits. The Exhibit Marking panel has a Previously marked… button (Shift+F9). Pick its colour in App Settings → Files & Exhibits → Exhibit stamping.
The Mark button takes your sticker's colour. Batch stamp moved off the Exhibit Marking panel; it's still in the menus and in Stamp Exhibits.
Exhibit Details: a document already on the Display shows “✓ On the Display” instead of “Show again”. If you've changed it on the Counsel Table, the button says “Show changes”.
Stamping now shows the new ID (EX54) in Files & Exhibits right away.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Exhibit stamping settings in one place · Previously marked IDs never clash
intro: The stamping options and the open-files option are now in App Settings → Files & Exhibits.

items.t: App Settings → Files & Exhibits now holds “Word, Excel & other files” (open them in their own program) and a new Exhibit stamping card. The card has: Stamping sets the ID (EX1 / DX4 / PX12), Previously marked sets the ID (your own pattern), and Previously marked renames the File Name. These options apply to every job; they are no longer in Job Settings.

Previously marked asks for the witness or deposition, so Smith 12 and Johns 12 get their own IDs (PrevSmith12, PrevJohns12). An ID already used by another file is refused, with a note to add the name.
Reading links on scanned pages now works in the installed app, not only from source.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Open links in documents · Previously marked exhibits · Jobs keep their layout
intro: Right-click a web link in any document, even a scanned one, to open it. Previously marked exhibits get their own quick step. Each job now opens with the layout you saved in it.

items.t: Right-click a web link in a document to open it in your browser or copy it. This works on links typed in the text, and on scanned pages: “Open a link here… (reads the page)” finds the address on the picture.
items.where: Right-click the page on the Counsel Table

items.t: Previously marked exhibits: right-click a file → Previously marked…, or press Shift+F9. Pick the exhibit type and number: the ID becomes Prev12 (PrevDX4 for Defendant’s 4). No sticker is added and no number is used up. App Settings can also rename the File Name with your own pattern (off by default).
Stamping can set the exhibit’s ID: Exhibit 1 → EX1, Defendant’s 4 → DX4, Plaintiff’s 12 → PX12, with no spaces. It is off by default (App Settings). Unmark puts the old ID back.
An exhibit that is already marked can’t be marked again by accident. You’ll see a message with an Unmark button instead.
Each job opens with its own layout: panels, panel windows and tool groups. That layout wins over App Settings. Panel windows also stay remembered when you quit.
Word, Excel and other non-PDF files no longer open in their own program on call-up unless you turn that on.
items.where: App Settings → General → “Open them automatically in their own program”

items.t: File Names in Files & Exhibits are yellow by default (a darker amber on the light theme) so they stand apart from the ID.
Display label: your text sits left or center (the only choices), and “Valu-Present” always stays at the right end, so centered text stays centered.
Rotate all pages and save on a marked exhibit: the sticker now turns with the page and stays in the same spot, and saved screens keep what they showed.
Zoom: a quick drag, or a flat swipe along a line of text, now always zooms.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Clearer update notes
intro: The update history is rewritten: what changes how you work is explained; small fixes are listed as minor.

items.t: What’s New and the website’s update history now explain each release in plain words — New, Changed and Important fix — with small fixes rolled into one line.
items.where: Help → What’s New · Help → All updates

title: Re-syncing keeps your first sync · History finds what was called out
intro: Re-syncing a deposition no longer overwrites the sync you already have, and History can now be searched by what you called out.

items.t: Syncing a deposition that is already synced now creates a new copy — “Name (new sync)”, in the same witness folder. Your existing sync stays exactly as it was, so you can compare the two and keep whichever you want (rename or delete the other). A deposition that is not synced yet is synced in place, as before.

History search finds callouts and highlights by what they cover — “1st paragraph”, “footer 117”, or any word inside the marked text. The entry opens on the matching step; click it to put that screen back. Search Everything finds them too.
History shows how each screen reached the Display: L = Live, S = Show.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: New sync engine — VALU-SYNC 2.0
intro: Syncing a transcript to its video now uses the VALU-SYNC 2.0 engine: more exact line times, and it tells you where the recording has no sound instead of guessing.

items.t: The VALU-SYNC 2.0 engine lines up every transcript line with the moment its first word is spoken. Lines that are in the transcript but were never said are flagged rather than squeezed in. It runs on your computer; the first sync downloads it once (about 100 MB, one click).

No-audio check: stretches of the video with no sound are found and shown in bold red (e.g. NO AUDIO DETECTED 0:00:00–0:26:26 · pages 4–20). Lines in those stretches get no time — never a guess. A silent microphone channel or a video with no sound at all is reported too.

Manual Sync — play, listen, mark: click the line you hear and press Space as it is spoken; the next line is selected for you. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes. After three marks, Sync Forward re-lines up the rest of that video from your marks. Lines you mark by hand are never moved by any later sync.
items.where: Transcript: M, or right-click a line

items.t: Right-click any line: Sync Forward from here, or Re-sync the selected lines from the audio.
Find words on the Display: Alt+F searches the document on the Counsel Table; Alt+Shift+F searches the document the witness is seeing — its page turns and the words are outlined there.
History describes what you marked: “Callout — 1st paragraph …”, “Highlight — line starting Q. Did you …”, “Callout — footer · 117”.
Typing a page number: the Go to page box now waits for Enter (Esc cancels).
Exhibit labels can carry a small “display screen by Valu-Present” in the far corner — on by default, off in Settings → Exhibit Labels. It is on the screen only, never on stamped exhibits.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Stamp Exhibits — a cleaner step-by-step
intro: The Stamp Exhibits steps are simpler to follow from start to finish.

items.t: Stamp Exhibits is now one of the three choices in New Case (Ctrl+N), next to Deposition and Trial / Arbitration.

Batch stamping walks you through it: where the finished files go → the full sticker settings → the files → the list to check → Batch process all. When it is done: open the folder, start another batch, go back to the start screen, or quit.
Each stamp job starts with a clean slate — your sticker design and company carry over; the reporter, CSR and job details start blank.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Stamp Exhibits: Live or Batch · numbers read from file names
intro: Stamping starts with one question — Live (during a session) or Batch (a set of files) — and the exhibit numbers come from the file names.

items.t: Live: name the session and where it is saved, then bring in the documents. The exhibit numbers in the file names are used; if the names are not consistent, the files are numbered 1, 2, 3.

Batch reads exhibit numbers anywhere in a file name — at the start, at the end, after EX / Exhibit / PX — and gaps are fine (21, 32–35, 80…). Dates and Bates numbers are ignored. Files with no number or a duplicate are listed so you can rename them and try again, or number them in order.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Name an exhibit without a sticker
intro: For exhibits with an objection pending.

items.t: Name as exhibit only: right-click a file to make a copy named as the exhibit and use the number — without a sticker. Add the sticker later (same number, same file) or unmark it.
Finished batch files go next to the originals in a MARKED FINALS folder by default, or a folder you choose.
Batch stamping no longer reads a date at the start of a file name as the exhibit number.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Word, Excel and PowerPoint stay Word, Excel and PowerPoint
intro: Marked Office files are never turned into PDFs.

items.t: Marking a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file always puts the sticker into a copy of that same file type — never a PDF — so the file of record keeps its format.
Files that cannot hold a sticker (old .doc / .xls / .ppt, Pages, Keynote, RTF, email) get the renamed copy, the sticker as a picture at its real size, and short steps for adding it in that program.
Marked files show in red in Files & Exhibits with their exhibit number, so you can see at a glance what is done and what is left.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Exhibit types, your own sticker design, smarter numbering
intro: Stickers for every kind of case, your own sticker artwork, and exhibit numbers taken from file names or the transcript.

items.t: Exhibit types for every case — Plaintiff’s, Defendant’s, Joint, Claimant’s, Respondent’s, Petitioner’s, Third-party, Court’s, Government — each in its standard color, printed long (PLAINTIFF’S EXHIBIT 1) or short (PX 1), with the witness name in front if you want it.
The saved file name is set separately from the sticker — the sticker can say SMITH EXHIBIT 1 while the file is “Exhibit 1.pdf”.
The sticker’s bottom band can show the agency, the court reporter and CSR number, or both, plus a case number line.
Import your own sticker design; Valu-Present finds where the number and date go and uses it for live, batch and Office stamping.
Batch stamping can take the numbers from the file names, or from a deposition’s exhibit index — and then links each exhibit in the testimony where it is first mentioned.
Designations: the party is asked once (for an imported list, or your first one by hand); every new designation then follows that side until you switch.
Exporting clip videos shows progress with Cancel.
Opening or closing a panel no longer changes the size of your other panels, in any job.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Switch any job to stamping
intro: Finished a deposition without stamping? Stamp it afterwards.

items.t: Any job can switch to Stamp Exhibits mode: it sets the MARKED folder and opens batch stamping with every unstamped file ticked.
Stamp Exhibits mode shows only what stamping needs; leave it any time from ＋ Add.
Minor fixes and enhancements.
Stamp Exhibits on the Welcome screen now creates its job and MARKED folder correctly.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Stamp Exhibits mode and batch stamping
intro: A new way to work: a job that only stamps exhibits — live one at a time, or a whole set at once.

items.t: Stamp Exhibits mode: only your files, the page and the stamp tool.
items.where: Welcome screen · File → New Stamp Exhibits job

items.t: Batch stamping: check the sticker once and every file is stamped with the next number, in a clear spot on the page — PDFs, pictures (kept as pictures, at real size) and Word, Excel and PowerPoint (without opening Office). Originals are never changed.
Valu AI: Valu-Present uses the same on-computer A.I. models as your other Valu apps — no second download.
History is a tree: one line per document shown; open it to see every step (zoom, callouts, highlights) and click a step to put it back.
Every list in the Case File has its own search box.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

title: Clip Maker: objections out in one click

items.t: Objections and attorney talk inside a clip have their own card: Remove all, Keep, or Put back — or always remove them on new clips.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

Remove dead space now takes out pauses inside and between questions and answers (¾ s or more, adjustable), measured against the room’s own background noise — so air conditioning or a hum no longer hides the pauses.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

Making a clip finds the attorney talk between question and answer — objections, colloquy, “off the record” — and asks whether to remove it. Every cut is listed so you can listen to the join, adjust it or put it back.
Minor fixes and enhancements.

Every account is a firm account: each person signs in with their own email and gets a seat from the firm’s pool, usable on a main and a backup computer. The firm’s master login manages seats and users on the account page.
Minor fixes and enhancements.
Minor fixes.

title: Adding documents to a deposition, as before

items.t: A new deposition goes straight to the Add Media window — no questions about sides or witnesses (those are for trial cases).
Case Settings is now called Job Settings.
Exhibit Marking turns on when you set up the sticker, so its panel always shows.
Minor fixes and enhancements.
A trial or beta period starts the day you first activate Valu-Present, not the day the account was made.
Firm accounts: everyone at a firm signs in with their own email and shares the firm’s seats; administrators add and remove people on the account page.
Terms version 1.1 (effective October 14, 2026): firm accounts and seats, exactly what reaches our server (never your case files), and on-computer A.I. and speech recognition.
Minor fixes and enhancements.
Minor enhancements.
Minor fixes.
Any theme can follow macOS / Windows light and dark mode.
Side by side, three and four panes: every document on screen opens in Files & Exhibits, not just the first one.
Minor fixes and enhancements.
Minor enhancements to custom looks and the Theme Creator.

title: SHOW and LIVE marked in the file list
